[[File:Bronze scimitar detail.png|left|120px]]
The '''bronze scimitar''' is a [[scimitar]] made of [[Bronze equipment|bronze]]. The weakest scimitar in the game, it requires level 1 [[Attack]] to wield. Players can make a bronze scimitar with level 5 [[Smithing]] using 2 [[bronze bar]]s, granting 25 Smithing [[experience]]. Players can purchase this scimitar from [[Zeke's Superior Scimitars]] in [[Al Kharid]].

One can be found for free on the top floor of a house in [[Rimmington]].

There is also a bronze scimitar spawn in [[Corsair Cove]], in the hut with [[Arsen the Thief]] and [[Cabin Boy Colin]].
